name: public-schedule-case-03
refusal: The one-time schedule needs a time with its own UTC offset.

name: public-schedule-case-04
refusal: The one-time schedule has no run time.

name: public-schedule-case-05
refusal: The one-time schedule's run time could not be read.

name: public-schedule-case-06
refusal: Atum's cloud does not run a schedule more often than once an hour. Choose an hourly or slower cadence, or a daily, weekly or monthly time.

name: public-schedule-case-07
refusal: Repeat intervals must be a whole number of hours (for example every 2 hours).

name: public-schedule-case-08
refusal: Repeating every N hours is not available in the schedule list yet. Use a daily, weekly or monthly time (for example daily at 09:00), or a one-time schedule.

name: public-schedule-case-09
refusal: Repeat intervals can be at most one year; use a monthly or one-time schedule instead.

name: public-schedule-case-10
refusal: The repeat interval could not be read.

name: public-schedule-case-16
refusal: The weekdays must be plain numbers, lists or ranges (for example 1-5 or 1,3,5).

name: public-schedule-case-19
refusal: Monthly schedules run on days 1 to 28, so every month has the day.

name: public-schedule-case-20
refusal: The day of the month must be one number (lists, ranges and steps are not supported).

name: public-schedule-case-21
refusal: A schedule on both a day of the month and a weekday is not supported; choose one.

name: public-schedule-case-22
refusal: A schedule limited to certain months is not supported. Use a monthly day or a one-time schedule.

name: public-schedule-case-23
refusal: The schedule repeats within the day (a wildcard, range or step in the minute or hour). Atum's cloud runs a schedule at one time of day: use 'M H * * *' for daily, weekly with weekdays, or a day of the month.

name: public-schedule-case-24
refusal: The schedule repeats within the day (a wildcard, range or step in the minute or hour). Atum's cloud runs a schedule at one time of day: use 'M H * * *' for daily, weekly with weekdays, or a day of the month.

name: public-schedule-case-25
refusal: Only five-field cron expressions (minute hour day month weekday) are supported.

name: public-schedule-case-26
refusal: That schedule form is not supported.

name: public-schedule-case-27
refusal: That schedule form is not supported.
